actions.name: pack tactics
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: running leap
actions.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can Long Jump up to 25 feet.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmRend0000000000]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .mmRoar0000000000]].

actions.name: roar
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Igeu89TALGlNPXDg]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=Igeu89TALGlNPXDg]] feet. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
